user.title: Ornament Health
user.description: Paste the API token from your Ornament account. It is stored in Home Assistant only and is never written anywhere else.

data_description.token: Bearer token for the Ornament public API.

profile.title: Choose a person
profile.description: These are the profiles linked to your Ornament account. Add the integration again to track another person.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the Ornament token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {name} is no longer accepted. Paste a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Ornament API. Check your connection and try again.
error.no_profiles: This token has no linked profiles.
error.profile_missing: This token does not have access to the person configured in this entry.

abort.already_configured: This person is already set up.

data.import_history: Import measurement history into long-term statistics
data.history_attribute_limit: Measurements kept in the history attribute

data_description.import_history: Backfills past lab results so history graphs show every measurement, not just the ones recorded since installation.
data_description.history_attribute_limit: Set to 0 to leave the history attribute out entirely.
data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often to check Ornament for new lab results. Minimum 15 minutes.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Refreshes data from Ornament and re-imports every biomarker measurement into long-term statistics.

resync.name: Resync everything
resync.description: Deletes the imported measurement history and rebuilds it from Ornament. Use when the data looks wrong.
